name: Create New File From Template
description: Create a new Google Docs file from a template. Optionally include placeholders in the template document that will get replaced from this action. [See documentation](https://www.npmjs.com/package/google-docs-mustaches)

configurable_props.name: drive
configurable_props.label: Drive Containing Template
configurable_props.description: Defaults to `My Drive`. To select a [Shared Drive](https://support.google.com/a/users/answer/9310351) instead, select it from this list.

configurable_props.name: templateId
configurable_props.label: File
configurable_props.description: Select the template document you'd like to use as the template, or use a custom expression to reference a document ID from a previous step. Template documents should contain placeholders in the format `{{xyz}}`.

configurable_props.name: destinationDrive
configurable_props.label: Destination Drive
configurable_props.description: Defaults to `My Drive`. To select a [Shared Drive](https://support.google.com/a/users/answer/9310351) instead, select it from this list.

configurable_props.name: folderId
configurable_props.label: Folder
configurable_props.description: Select the folder of the newly created Google Doc and/or PDF, or use a custom expression to reference a folder ID from a previous step.

configurable_props.name: name
configurable_props.label: Name
configurable_props.description: Name of the file you want to create (eg. `myFile` will create a Google Doc called `myFile` and a pdf called `myFile.pdf`)

configurable_props.name: mode
configurable_props.label: Mode
configurable_props.description: Specify if you want to create a Google Doc, PDF or both.

configurable_props.name: replaceValues
configurable_props.label: Replace text placeholders
configurable_props.description: Replace text placeholders in the document. Use the format `{{xyz}}` in the document but exclude the curly braces in the key. (eg. `{{myPlaceholder}}` in the document will be replaced by the value of the key `myPlaceholder` in the action.
